annotations.title: The Semitone Motif (E - D# - E)
annotations.instruction: Play the opening E-D#-E oscillation with fingers 5-4-5 using supple micro-wrist rotation. Do not lift fingers tensely off the ivory.

annotations.title: F Major Episode (Dolce e Cantabile)
annotations.instruction: Warm, sunny F major character. Roll the 32nd-note decorative turn gently and bring out the upper singing voice.

annotations.title: A Minor Pedal Point Storm & Chromatic Run
annotations.instruction: Keep the continuous LH 16th-note repeated A2 pedal point ominous and controlled, while RH articulates intense chords leading into the ascending Bb arpeggio and descending chromatic cascade.

sections.title: Episode B: F Major Sunshine
sections.character: Lyrical, singing melody and cheerful ornaments

sections.title: Episode C: Thunderous Repeated Bass & Chromatic Cascade
sections.character: Dark rumbling pedal point and dazzling chromatic sweep

sections.title: Final Recapitulation A & Serene Coda
sections.character: Gentle fading resolution into quiet final A minor chord
